method.runtime: Python standard library only; no external audio/FFT dependencies
method.spectral_analysis: Mean-removed whole-sample unwindowed radix-two FFT with zero padding; one-sided bins excluding DC
method.correlation: Absolute normalized correlation on four-frame box-averaged PCM, zero-padded, lags +/-12 reduced-rate samples
method.levels: Nominal pack gain applied linearly; app volume curve, system volume compensation and playback-volume clamping excluded
method.comparison_rms: Peak rolling20ms RMS and equivalent100ms RMS use fixed-time denominators; trailing silence cannot lower either measurement
method.review_thresholds: Review flags are screening prompts, not automatic rejection: endpoint>1LSB, absDC>0.001, onset>5ms, correlation>0.98, variantEnergySpread>3dB, baselineEnergyDifference>6dB
method.scope: Quantitative PCM checks; does not establish audible quality, perceived loudness equality, or performance on physical speakers
